Hi team,

We need to lock the virtual onsite for Talya Brooks (SWE IC, applied to Core Systems). BrightHire has confirmed she's available next Tue/Wed window (9/12-9/13) PST. Goal: 4 interview slots (2 x 60m + 2 x 45m) covering:
- System design (60)
- Coding (60)
- Debug/triage + infra questions (45)
- Behavioral / leadership (45)

- Keep the two deep-technical slots separated by at least a 30m buffer to allow recovery and short async prep.
- Prefer coding first for warmup, but open to swapping if it helps availability.
- We need one interviewer to own the debrief notes and submit within 2 hours post-loop.

Action items: please reply with:
1) Which day/slots you can take (9/12 or 9/13)
2) Which slot (design/coding/debug/behavior) you prefer
3) Any hard constraints (e.g., midday unavailability)

Thanks,
